# Pull Request (research-only default)

<!-- Template adopted from the Chat 2 market-eval review proposal
     (chat2-review-overnight-20261013/market_eval/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md,
     2026-10-14). Nothing aspirational may appear under "What". -->

## Status
<!-- Choose one: DRAFT / READY-FOR-REVIEW / REVIEWED (cite verdict) / SUPERSEDED (cite replacement) -->

## What (implemented)
<!-- What this PR changes, file scope, and which execution paths exist. No aspirational language. -->

## Tests (run on this head)
<!-- Exact command(s), pass counts, and the CI run URL for THIS head SHA. -->

## Measured results (if any)
<!-- Numbers with: population (rows/starts/dates), metric convention, uncertainty (paired CI), and the artifact path/hash they came from. Separate preliminary vs verified. -->

## Proposed / NOT-STARTED
<!-- Ideas referenced but not implemented here. Nothing aspirational may appear under "What". -->

## Evidence and provenance
<!-- Full head SHA; artifact paths + hashes; experiment card/section; reviewer findings file + hash. -->

## Deviations and disclosures
<!-- Any deviation from the registered plan, with links (e.g., INCIDENT.md entries). -->

## Gates
<!-- Explicitly state: no merge without owner authorization; no outcome scoring without separate authorization; no model promotion without scientific evidence. -->

## Reviewer
<!-- Verdict, SHA it applies to, findings-file hash. -->
